name: eevee-material-stencil-reader-mask
purpose: Verify that EEVEE material stencil/template readers use writer-produced user stencil bits as a screen-space mask without blocking the writer during the regular prepass.
passCriteria: A red stencil reader is visible only inside a smaller writer plane mask, becomes invisible when the reader test is NEVER or the writer is disabled, and becomes fully visible when the reader stencil test is disabled.
